bio: Christina Schwarz paints flowers in watercolour: poppies in a summer field, anemones, a pair of violets, the last sunflower of the season. She works on heavy cotton paper, often wet into wet, and lets the pigment settle where it wants to, so each petal keeps a little of the water that made it.

Born in Germany, she has lived in Canada for many years and paints from a small studio with north light. Her watercolours have been shown in solo and group exhibitions and are in private collections in Canada and Europe.
